commits.message:
fix: New badge only for entries that are actually new (#7463)

The pill was decided from a URL-keyed map of "URLs that appeared on an added
diff line in the last 30 days". That is not the same as an entry being new,
and it produced visible false positives: Metrolist, listed since December
2024, showed "New, added 2026-11-25" on both /mobile and /audio because one
commit inserted its link on the audio page, and masscan, ShredOS, APKCombo,
bookstack and AnimeGO all showed up as new after wording or URL edits to
long-standing lines.

What changes:

- The map is keyed by page as well as URL ("mobile.md|https://..."), so a page
  that inserts a link no longer badges the same link on every other page that
  already lists it.
- An entry only counts as new if its label did not already appear in that file
  at the parent commit. That covers rewritten bullets (masscan or RustScan),
  link swaps (GameBounty, CDRomance) and re-lists without any rename detection.
- docs/.vitepress/added-dates.json holds known first-appearance dates for
  entries older than the 30-day window, which is what keeps a re-added URL
  from looking new. It can only make an entry look older, never newer.
- Anything unresolved stays unbadged instead of falling back to today.

Unchanged: the badge is still a real button with real "New" text, so Ctrl+F
and copy still see it, the cursor stays a pointer, and the li.new hookup and
the hover tooltip are untouched.

Verified without a docs build: `node --test tests/new-badge.test.mjs` (16
passing, covering page scoping, name identity, known dates, renames, removed
URLs and genuinely new entries), `node scripts/new-badge-report.mjs` (shows
Metrolist, masscan, APKCombo and ShredOS unbadged while a genuine addition
keeps its date), and a one-off replay of the real parent-commit blobs for
ce8a8d73cb, edec9cd231, dd9cf3c51a and 05305b2a5a. A full VitePress build was
not run locally.

Co-authored-by: eli32-vlc <eli32.vlc@gmail.com>
